title: David Patterson - A New Golden Age for Computer Architecture: History, Challenges and Opportunities
summary: David Patterson's talk on the history of computer architecture, from RISC and superscalar designs to the end of Dennard scaling and Moore's Law. It argues that domain-specific architectures and open instruction sets open a new golden age.
why: Recommended, including by Chris Lattner, as a history of CPU architecture and why performance gains slowed.

quote.text: The other talk Dr. Chris Lattner recommends watching is this one, and is very interesting
